semantics.event_cycles: tile handshakes sampled preedge; fill sampled postedge of that numbered edge
semantics.interaccept_gaps: observed controller-acceptance separations; include other clients, refresh, idle and demand timing; not controller service or recoverable critical path
semantics.lookup: accepted handshake, not first valid assertion; F-to-Q alone cannot prove fill latency was hidden
semantics.physical_command_tile_join: address coordinate joined within matching context window and checked against explicit bank map; raw owner remains unknown
semantics.raw_command_owner_generation: 0 means UNKNOWN; context window is not transaction owner
semantics.stream_counters: actual RTL predicates; candidate_wait includes accepted cycles, idle_candidate_wait also does not imply an unserved request; do not label them controller blockage or predicted savings
semantics.write_interval: accepted candidate write to accepted receiver completion; includes physical work and any held retirement; backend terminal completion is not separately traced
